meta.title: Stage A instrument blueprints: SOFR OIS (plain, observation shift, shift + lockout), SOFR averaging swaps, SOFR futures, €STR OIS, EURIBOR swaps, 3s6s basis, EURIBOR futures, front-end deposits
meta.description: Each blueprint names a convention of blueprints/conventions/instruments.json and the coupon kind every leg records with (include/epykos/maths/instrument/blueprint.hpp); a trade of the population supplies notional, side, dates, tenor and rate. The coupon mechanics are code (maths/instrument/coupon.hpp); the observation windows, lags and day counts come from the convention. Sources: the convention's own citations (docs/G4_BUNDLE.md USD.3-USD.5, EUR.3-EUR.6) and the ISDA 2021 Definitions / ARRC formulas for compounding in arrears and averaging (G4_BUNDLE.md section 6).
sources: docs/G4_BUNDLE.md sections USD.3, USD.4, USD.5, EUR.3, EUR.4, EUR.5, EUR.6 (the conventions each blueprint names)
ARRC, A User's Guide to SOFR (2021): compounding in arrears, payment delay, lookback, observation shift, lockout; simple (arithmetic) average
ISDA 2021 Interest Rate Derivatives Definitions section 7.3 OIS compounding formula; Overnight Averaging (as cited in the ISDA Good Friday 2026 guidance)
CME SR3 / SR1 and Eurex FEU3 contract specifications: price = 100 minus the rate; convexity adjustment zero and stated (PROBLEM.md section 9, D35)
notes: Curve slots: the discount curve of a blueprint is its convention's discount_index (else the currency's), the projection curve of a float leg its index; the caller maps index names to curve objects (builder.hpp CurveSlots).

Futures notional: the contract value at 100 points times the number of contracts (SR3 and SR1: 250,000 USD per contract = 2,500 USD per point; FEU3: 250,000 EUR); the PV of a position is (price - traded price) / 100 x notional, undiscounted (variation margin).

USD-SOFR-OIS.description: USD fixed vs SOFR compounded in arrears (plain), the interdealer standard.

USD-SOFR-OIS-SHIFT2.description: USD fixed vs SOFR compounded with a two business day observation shift (customised).

USD-SOFR-OIS-SHIFT2-LOCKOUT2.description: USD fixed vs SOFR compounded with a two business day observation shift and a two business day lockout (customised).

USD-SOFR-AVG-SWAP.description: USD fixed vs the arithmetic average of daily SOFR (does not telescope).

USD-SOFR-ON-DEPOSIT.description: The overnight SOFR fixing as a one-day deposit (the curve's first instrument).

USD-SOFR-3M-FUTURE.description: CME SR3: 100 minus compounded SOFR over the IMM quarter; convexity zero (stated).

USD-SOFR-1M-FUTURE.description: CME SR1: 100 minus the arithmetic average of daily SOFR over the calendar month; convexity zero (stated).

EUR-ESTR-OIS.description: EUR fixed vs €STR compounded in arrears (plain).

EUR-ESTR-ON-DEPOSIT.description: The overnight €STR fixing as a one-day deposit.

EUR-EURIBOR-3M-DEPOSIT.description: The 3M EURIBOR fixing as a spot-starting three-month deposit.

EUR-EURIBOR-6M-DEPOSIT.description: The 6M EURIBOR fixing as a spot-starting six-month deposit.

EUR-EURIBOR-3M-IRS.description: EUR fixed annual 30/360 vs 3M EURIBOR quarterly, fixing in advance.

EUR-EURIBOR-6M-IRS.description: EUR fixed annual 30/360 vs 6M EURIBOR semi-annual, fixing in advance.

EUR-3S6S-BASIS.description: EUR 3M EURIBOR + spread (quarterly) vs 6M EURIBOR flat (semi-annual), €STR-discounted; the spread on the 3M leg.

EUR-EURIBOR-3M-FUTURE.description: Eurex FEU3: 100 minus the 3M EURIBOR fixing of the last trading day; the deposit from the third Wednesday for three months; convexity zero (stated).
